!
hostname rt-g01
!
service timestamps debug datetime msec
service timestamps log datetime msec localtime
service password-encryption
!
logging buffered 65536 warnings
!
username admin privilege 15 secret 0 dummy-admin-secret-1
!
class-map match-any cm-g-voice
 match cos 5
 match qos-group 10
!
policy-map pm-g-in
 class cm-g-voice
  set qos-group 10
policy-map pm-g-out
 class cm-g-voice
  priority percent 20
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0
 description sample wan
 no ip address
 pppoe enable group global
 pppoe-client dial-pool-number 1
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/1
 description sample lan
 ip address 198.51.100.1 255.255.255.0
 service-policy input pm-g-in
 service-policy output pm-g-out
!
interface Dialer1
 description sample pppoe
 ip address negotiated
 ip mtu 1454
 ip tcp adjust-mss 1414
 encapsulation ppp
 dialer pool 1
 dialer-group 1
 ppp authentication chap
 ppp chap hostname example-user@example.net
 ppp chap password 0 dummy-ppp-password
!
ip route 0.0.0.0 0.0.0.0 Dialer1
!
dialer-list 1 protocol ip permit
!
line con 0
 exec-timeout 5 30
line vty 0 4
 exec-timeout 10 0
 transport input ssh
!
end
